10-UNITNING BEShINChI BETI (74-bet).

Yuqorida chapda YaShIL yorliqda oq '10' va 'Stick to the Rules!'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Reading & Listening'.
16) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen to three news reports (A - C) and match them to the accidents (1 - 3).' Accident: 1 a fall from a cliff, 2 an accident while skiing, 3 an accident in a park; News Report (katakchalar).
17) a) 'Match the headlines (1-3) to the signs (A-C).' SARLAVHALAR (gazeta qirqmalari): 1 CHILD SAVED FROM DROWNING IN POND; 2 BRITISH SKIER TRAPPED IN SNOW; 3 VISIT TO BEACH ENDS IN FALL ONTO ROCKS. BELGILAR: A - qizil oval 'DANGER', 'DO NOT CLIMB THE CLIFFS'; B - yashil 'NOTICE', 'DO NOT SKI ON UNMARKED SLOPES'; C - yashil 'SAFETY FIRST', 'DO NOT LET YOUNG CHILDREN PLAY ALONE NEAR WATER'.
    b) 'Match the words/phrases to the headlines (1 - 3) above, then try to explain what each word/phrase means.' Qiya: edge of pond, climb, main slopes, ski resort, drowned, mountain rescue team, swim, cliffs, Coastguard
18) a) 'Read the three news reports and fill in the correct headlines from Ex. 17a, then explain the words in bold.'
   XABAR A (pushti, uch xatboshi raqamli): [1] Six-year-old Pamela Kinsey nearly drowned in a pond in Carlton Park, Coddleton, yesterday afternoon. [2] The accident OCCURRED at 3:30 pm as Pamela and her nine-year-old brother were playing at the edge of the pond. When his sister fell into the pond, Kyle, who cannot swim, ran to get help. He was afraid she would drown. Fortunately, the PARK WARDEN managed to SAVE little Pamela. [3] SINCE the accident, Coddleton Council has PUT UP a high FENCE around the pond. LOCAL POLICE are WARNING parents not to let young children play alone near water.

O'NG USTUN:
   XABAR B (binafsha): 42-year-old Marcus Hirst was injured when he fell onto rocks on a beach near Dover yesterday morning. Mr Hirst was on a day trip to the beach with his wife and two young children when he decided to climb the cliffs in search of birds' eggs. He fell from a HEIGHT of about twelve metres onto the rocks below. His wife called the AMBULANCE SERVICE on her MOBILE PHONE and Mr Hirst was taken to hospital in a Coastguard helicopter. He had a broken leg and arm, but SUFFERED no other injuries. Since the accident, the Coastguard has put up signs on the beach warning people not to climb the cliffs.
   XABAR C (sarg'ish): Robert Blakewell, a twenty-year-old student from Sussex, was trapped in a deep SNOWDRIFT in the French Alps on Tuesday. Robert was on holiday with some college friends at an Albertville ski resort when he decided to go skiing alone and away from the main slopes of the resort. His friends CONTACTED THE AUTHORITIES when Robert failed to return that evening. A mountain rescue team managed to find Robert and take him to the nearest hospital. After the accident, the Mountain Rescue Service RELEASED a STATEMENT to THE PRESS, asking skiers not to ski on unmarked slopes.
   b) 'Read the news reports again and answer the questions. Put A, B or C in each box.' 'Which report(s) mention(s) someone who ...' was involved in an accident yesterday? [1][2]; went somewhere alone? [3]; was injured when he/she was on holiday? [4]; was playing when the accident happened? [5]; was in or near water? [6][7]
   c) 'Look at news report A. Which paragraph describes the event in detail? Which paragraph gives a summary of the event? Which paragraph is about the action taken?'
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Read news reports B and C again, and make notes for each under the headings below. Then, use your notes to talk about each of the accidents.' Ko'k: • Who? What? Where? When? • Details of the Event • Action Taken

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '74'.

SARLAVHA → BELGI:

  1 CHILD SAVED FROM DROWNING IN POND

    water'
  2 BRITISH SKIER TRAPPED IN SNOW

  (chang'i yo'li emas).


⚠ 'A NOTICE':

  = avvalo xavfsizlik.

exercises.explanationUz:
UCh XABAR - TO'LIQ MATN VA TARJIMA.


⚠ YaNGILIK XABARI TUZILIShI
  (18c savoli):

  1-xatboshi: QISQAChA (kim, nima,
     qayerda, qachon)
  2-xatboshi: BATAFSIL voqea
  3-xatboshi: KO'RILGAN ChORA


⚠ ZAMONLAR:

  past simple - voqealar
  past continuous - fon ('were
     playing')
  present perfect - chora ('has put
     up')
  majhul nisbat - 'was injured',
     'was taken', 'was trapped'

points.en: [A-1] Six-year-old Pamela Kinsey nearly drowned in a pond in Carlton Park, Coddleton, yesterday afternoon.
points.uz: [A-1] Olti yoshli Pamela Kinsey kecha tushdan keyin Coddletondagi Carlton bog'idagi hovuzda cho'kib ketishiga sal qoldi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'nearly drowned' = cho'kishiga sal qoldi.
⚠ QISQAChA xatboshi: kim, nima, qayerda, qachon.

points.en: [A-2] The accident occurred at 3:30 pm as Pamela and her nine-year-old brother were playing at the edge of the pond. When his sister fell into the pond, Kyle, who cannot swim, ran to get help. He was afraid she would drown. Fortunately, the park warden managed to save little Pamela.
points.uz: [A-2] Hodisa soat 15:30 da Pamela va to'qqiz yoshli akasi hovuz chekkasida o'ynayotganida sodir bo'ldi. Singlisi hovuzga tushib ketganda, suzishni bilmaydigan Kyle yordam chaqirgani yugurdi. U singlisi cho'kib ketishidan qo'rqdi. Baxtiga, bog' qo'riqchisi kichkina Pamelani qutqarishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to occur' = sodir bo'lmoq (rasmiy).
⚠ 'a park warden' = bog' qo'riqchisi.
⚠ 'managed to' = muvaffaq bo'ldi.
⚠ BATAFSIL xatboshi.

points.en: [A-3] Since the accident, Coddleton Council has put up a high fence around the pond. Local police are warning parents not to let young children play alone near water.
points.uz: [A-3] Hodisadan beri Coddleton kengashi hovuz atrofiga baland panjara o'rnatdi. Mahalliy politsiya ota-onalarni yosh bolalarni suv yonida yolg'iz o'ynashga qo'ymaslikka ogohlantirmoqda.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a council' = shahar kengashi.
⚠ 'warn sb NOT TO do' = qilmaslikka
ogohlantirmoq.
⚠ ChORA xatboshi.

points.en: [B] 42-year-old Marcus Hirst was injured when he fell onto rocks on a beach near Dover yesterday morning. Mr Hirst was on a day trip to the beach with his wife and two young children when he decided to climb the cliffs in search of birds' eggs.
points.uz: [B] 42 yoshli Marcus Hirst kecha ertalab Dover yaqinidagi plyajda qoyalarga yiqilib jarohatlandi. Janob Hirst rafiqasi va ikki yosh bolasi bilan plyajga bir kunlik sayohatga chiqqan edi, u qush tuxumlarini qidirib qoyalarga chiqishga qaror qildi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a day trip' = bir kunlik sayohat.
⚠ 'in search of' = ... ni qidirib (55-bet).

points.en: He fell from a height of about twelve metres onto the rocks below. His wife called the ambulance service on her mobile phone and Mr Hirst was taken to hospital in a Coastguard helicopter. He had a broken leg and arm, but suffered no other injuries.
points.uz: U taxminan o'n ikki metr balandlikdan pastdagi qoyalarga yiqildi. Rafiqasi mobil telefonidan tez yordam xizmatiga qo'ng'iroq qildi va janob Hirst qirg'oq qo'riqlash xizmatining vertolyotida kasalxonaga olib borildi. Uning oyog'i va qo'li singan edi, lekin boshqa jarohat olmadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a height' = balandlik.
⚠ 'to suffer injuries' = jarohat olmoq.
⚠ 'was taken to hospital' - majhul, artiklsiz.

points.en: Since the accident, the Coastguard has put up signs on the beach warning people not to climb the cliffs.
points.uz: Hodisadan beri qirg'oq qo'riqlash xizmati plyajga odamlarni qoyalarga chiqmaslikka ogohlantiruvchi belgilar o'rnatdi.

points.en: [C] Robert Blakewell, a twenty-year-old student from Sussex, was trapped in a deep snowdrift in the French Alps on Tuesday. Robert was on holiday with some college friends at an Albertville ski resort when he decided to go skiing alone and away from the main slopes of the resort.
points.uz: [C] Sasseksdan yigirma yoshli talaba Robert Blakewell seshanba kuni Fransiya Alp tog'larida chuqur qor uyumida qamalib qoldi. Robert kollej do'stlari bilan Albertville chang'i kurortida ta'tilda edi, u yolg'iz, kurortning asosiy qiyaliklaridan uzoqda chang'i uchishga qaror qildi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a snowdrift' = qor uyumi.
⚠ 'a ski resort' = chang'i kurorti.
⚠ 'away from' = ... dan uzoqda.

points.en: His friends contacted the authorities when Robert failed to return that evening. A mountain rescue team managed to find Robert and take him to the nearest hospital.
points.uz: Robert o'sha kuni kechqurun qaytmagach, do'stlari rasmiy idoralarga murojaat qilishdi. Tog' qutqaruv jamoasi Robertni topib, eng yaqin kasalxonaga olib borishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'the authorities' = rasmiy idoralar.
⚠ 'to fail to do' = qila olmaslik.

points.en: After the accident, the Mountain Rescue Service released a statement to the press, asking skiers not to ski on unmarked slopes.
points.uz: Hodisadan keyin Tog' qutqaruv xizmati matbuotga bayonot berib, chang'ichilardan belgilanmagan qiyaliklarda uchmaslikni so'radi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to release a statement' = bayonot bermoq.
⚠ 'the press' = matbuot.

exercises.exampleEn: Marcus Hirst, a 42-year-old man, was injured when he fell onto rocks on a beach near Dover yesterday morning.
exercises.exampleUz: 42 yoshli Marcus Hirst kecha ertalab Dover yaqinidagi plyajda qoyalarga yiqilib jarohatlandi.
modelAnswers: Marcus Hirst, a 42-year-old man, was injured when he fell onto rocks on a beach near Dover yesterday morning.

He was on a day trip with his family when he climbed the cliffs to look for birds' eggs and fell about twelve metres. His wife called an ambulance and he was taken to hospital by helicopter with a broken leg and arm.
Since then, the Coastguard has put up signs warning people not to climb the cliffs.
Robert Blakewell, a twenty-year-old student, was trapped in a snowdrift in the French Alps on Tuesday.

He was on holiday at a ski resort and went skiing alone, away from the main slopes. When he didn't return, his friends contacted the authorities and a mountain rescue team found him and took him to hospital.
After the accident, the Mountain Rescue Service released a statement asking skiers not to ski on unmarked slopes.
modelAnswersUz: 42 yoshli Marcus Hirst kecha ertalab Dover yaqinidagi plyajda qoyalarga yiqilib jarohatlandi.

U oilasi bilan bir kunlik sayohatda edi, qush tuxumlarini qidirib qoyalarga chiqdi va o'n ikki metrdan yiqildi. Rafiqasi tez yordam chaqirdi va u singan oyoq va qo'l bilan vertolyotda kasalxonaga olib borildi.
O'shandan beri qirg'oq qo'riqlash xizmati odamlarni qoyalarga chiqmaslikka ogohlantiruvchi belgilar o'rnatdi.
Yigirma yoshli talaba Robert Blakewell seshanba kuni Fransiya Alp tog'larida qor uyumida qamalib qoldi.

U chang'i kurortida ta'tilda edi va asosiy qiyaliklardan uzoqda yolg'iz chang'i uchdi. U qaytmagach, do'stlari rasmiy idoralarga murojaat qildi va tog' qutqaruv jamoasi uni topib kasalxonaga olib bordi.
Hodisadan keyin Tog' qutqaruv xizmati chang'ichilardan belgilanmagan qiyaliklarda uchmaslikni so'rab bayonot berdi.
